compat_notes: VERDICT line is emitted FIRST so line-1-only parsers (case-V6/selftest.sh class_of) see a verdict token immediately.

CRLF semantics are r2-faithful: the trailing CR of a CRLF row is NOT stripped; it rides the row's last field. On a canonical 6-column row that field is note (harmless); on a row truncated after the hash columns the CR lands on vault_sha256 and the digest comparison fails (case-V6 T7 boundary).
Header-indexed ledger parse: extra interleaved columns are honored via header names; canonical order is the fallback when the header is missing.
Empty-field-preserving row split (manual tab split) so short rows cannot silently shift fields left.

Two observed V6 failures during an early run were a concurrent sibling-builder race on the shared case-dir ledgers (rows had been rewritten with another run's /tmp paths); direct probes of the same ledgers verify, and all subsequent runs are green.
